pages.text: Sword kladenets: damage 8.5, attack speed 1.6, durability 1700, fireproof. Every blow also cuts the foes around: 6 damage within 3 blocks.
Seven-league boots: armour 3, toughness 2, durability 390. Speed III and Jump Boost.$(br)Cap of invisibility: armour 3, toughness 2, durability 330. While you sneak, no one can see you.
Elytra and the wings of Daedalus can go in the back slot (right of the player in the inventory) together with a chestplate: they fly and work just the same.
